purpose: GW001 exact competition_key counts Results vs Match Report
sql: SELECT competition_key, SUM(results_count) AS results_count, SUM(match_report_count) AS match_report_count FROM (SELECT competition_key,COUNT(*) results_count,0 match_report_count FROM `GW001_IMC Results` GROUP BY competition_key UNION ALL SELECT competition_key,0 results_count,COUNT(*) match_report_count FROM `GW001_IMC Match Report` GROUP BY competition_key) q GROUP BY competition_key ORDER BY competition_key
